origin.name: OCLP's OpenCore config.plist for MacBookPro9,2, after hao-opencore (and golden-gate-live-text-service)
origin.note: in the image's EFI partition, not in the System volume; dev images only (pack dev): an end-user image keeps hao-opencore's values

args.value: keepsyms=1 -lilubetaall ipc_control_port_options=0 -nokcmismatchpanic -pmap_pcid_disable amfi_get_out_of_my_way=1 hao_crash=1 hao_nx_stats=1 hao_bridge_stats=1 hao_diag_time=1 ic_csr_internal=1 auxKCAtBoot=false

edits.reason: hao-runtime's measurement switches after hao_crash=1: hao_nx_stats and hao_bridge_stats (NX fault tables, bridge statistics) and hao_diag_time (phase lines and usage counters boot-gantt reads); they cost time on every translated native call, so only bench images carry them
OpenCore's log goes to a file on the EFI partition (0x41), nothing on screen, so a bench boot's early evidence can be collected from Recovery; an end-user image writes no OpenCore log
the file log includes OpenCore's info lines (DisplayLevel 0x40)
